chapter_title: Nar Shaddaa: the Exchange, the yacht and the hidden master
about: Story state every completed run of the chapter ends with, for a skip-to-the-end feature. Curated in tools/questdb/chapters.py; values marked certain = false were worked out by reading the scripts or seen in one real save, not proven for every run.

journal.set_by: k_releader_death (004ebo) or dialog cahhmakt R14 (004ebo, stage 91): the lowest stage every run reaches, 91 >= 90
dialog tienn R21 / R22 / R23 / R52 (301nar, stages 40-43) or the TT-32 route (99): gotoyach E3 needs > 39, so 40 is the lowest stage every run reaches
dialog zezkaiel E145 (303nar). A shared tag: Onderon, Dantooine and Korriban set their own stages (50-77), so this stage alone does not mark Nar Shaddaa as played

dialog baosaber E11 (003ebo, a_quest_set|10): the Ebon Hawk's first scene after Telos (see CUT_BAODUR_LIGHTSABER), on the ship before any of the four planets, so every run that has played this chapter holds it

globals.name: 000_Jedi_Found
globals.note: the masters' count: zezkaiel E2 / E113 add 1. A counter several planets share; see JEDI_FOUND_RULE in this file. Left unchanged here

globals.name: 000_ZezKaiEll_Dead
globals.note: set to 1 only when the master is killed (k_zez_death, lostjedi 43); a full run talks to him. Left unchanged

globals.name: 003EBO_BACKGROUND
globals.note: tr_ehawk_custom sets 3 on every path when the party boards at 301nar

globals.name: 003EBO_RETURN_DEST
globals.note: tr_ehawk_custom sets 3 on every path when the party boards at 301nar

globals.name: 300NAR_Visquis_Call
globals.note: k_301_heartbeat; tr_ehawk_custom reads it on boarding

globals.name: 301_FIRST_ENTER
globals.note: k_301_enter (trigger 301Arrival) on landing

globals.name: 301NAR_Red_Eclipse_At
globals.note: dialog cahhmakt E9 (004ebo) sets 3 when the crew is talked off the ship; the fight sets 2 (k_releader_death): the player's choice, either ending LandingRights. The game tests only 1 (tr_ehawk_custom: the crew aboard sends every boarding to 004EBO; k_recspawn) and 0 (k_recspawn1), so 2 and 3 behave alike; a value is still needed because a save from before the chapter may hold 1

globals.name: 303NAR_Hanharr_Side
globals.note: light side: slot 7's route (305han2 R25); 007ebo k_enter007 reads it to pick miraend2 over hanend. Its writers of 1 are the dark route's replies hanhboun R19 (303nar) and 305han R17 (305nar) and a test node (genodisc R6, the cheat node E4); 305han R16 sets 0

globals.name: 304NAR_Visquis_Meet
globals.note: visquis R73 sets 1, zezkaiel R134 sets 2, and dialog visenter, which a_visquisconv starts only at 2, opens with E6 (its first start, c_global_eq 2): 3, the way into 305nar. No later writer; a_visleaveconv reads 3

globals.name: 351NAR_Ebon_Released
globals.note: the yacht's console (a_logout_power / 2 / 3): needed by k_351_miraend

globals.name: 351NAR_G0T0_Ship
globals.note: k_351_miraend, gotocut1 E10, 007ebo miraend2 / hanend E0; 303nar's k_303nar_enter and tr_ehawk_custom read it

globals.name: CUT_BAODUR_LIGHTSABER
globals.note: the table's third test: slot 1 available and 262TEL_Escape_Telos 1, nothing before it holds on the first entry after Telos (the attack on board needs two planets entered), so it plays on that arrival in every run; its dialog baosaber gives LightsaberQuest 10 (in this chapter's journal)
